summary: Viking Acquisition Corp. II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting issuance of a $514,080 convertible promissory note to its sponsor for working capital. The note is non-interest bearing, due at business combination or liquidation, and convertible at sponsor's election into units at $10 per unit, up to 51,408 units. This is a routine SPAC working capital loan, not a standalone special situation. Watch for future business combination announcement or liquidation if deal fails.
